[[File:Bronze plateskirt detail.png|120px|left]]
A '''bronze plateskirt''' is the weakest [[plateskirt]] in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. It has identical stat bonuses to the [[bronze platelegs]] but weighs less. A player with 16 [[Smithing]] can make it by using three [[bronze bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 37.5 smithing [[experience]]. They can be bought from [[Ranael's Super Skirt Store]] in [[Al Kharid]].
